name: Issues (Epics and Features)

meta.description: Work tracking for the coding pipeline, in GitHub Issues. Create an Epic for what the user wants, break it into Features (one shippable, testable unit each, written to a fixed template), read and comment on them, and move a Feature between draft, review and ready. The local coder builds only Features marked ready. Talks to the github-tool sidecar; the GitHub token never enters Open WebUI.
